reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original with no counterparty comment — exactly what a compliant finding should look like.

The cited language ('terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array') runs in favour of Ono, the customer/licensee we represent, so under the rule's detection guidance it is a benefit to our party and must not be redlined.

No language in the cited text or definitions imposes any obligation on Ono to extend better third-party terms to Array or to match third-party offers, supporting the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer).
Minor drafting imprecision in the rationale (placeholder 'Section 9.x(b)' citation and the aside about Article 8.2 exclusivity) does not affect the substance or the no-edit outcome.
